title: Two apartment towers planted with trees
episode: Tree-Covered Skyscrapers Aren't Actually That Green
description: Architect Stefano Boeri’s Bosco Verticale, two Porta Nuova apartment towers planted with hundreds of trees and finished in 2014. The B1M, a construction channel, asks whether the greenery makes up for the extra concrete and steel needed to carry it.

title: Two rival clubs, one ageing stadium
episode: San Siro: Why Time Is Almost Up For Milan's 'Colosseum' 🏟️ | BBC Sport
description: San Siro, officially the Stadio Giuseppe Meazza, opened in 1926 and is shared by AC Milan and Inter. BBC Sport looks at the clubs’ plans to replace the stadium and what the city stands to lose.

title: A duke’s daughter grows up at the Sforza court
episode: The Tigress of Forlì: Caterina Sforza 1 | Italian History
description: Extra History’s animated series on Caterina Sforza, daughter of Galeazzo Maria Sforza, Duke of Milan, starts with her childhood at the ducal court, which lived in the Castello Sforzesco, before marriage took her to Romagna.

title: A glass-roofed arcade between cathedral and opera
episode: ROCKY'S ITALY: Milan - The Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
description: Art historian Rocky Ruggiero on the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the iron-and-glass shopping arcade built from 1865 to 1877 to link the Duomo square with La Scala, named after Italy’s first king.

title: A tower shaped like a castle keep rises from bomb damage
episode: From the Ashes of World War II: Torre Velasca
description: Torre Velasca, the BBPR studio’s 1958 office and apartment tower, its upper floors jutting out like a medieval castle keep, rose on a bomb-damaged site. Architectural Record, the US architecture magazine, tells its postwar story.

title: Canals that once carried the cathedral’s marble
description: A short report from US news channel 9NEWS on the Navigli, the canals that linked Milan with lakes and rivers for centuries. Marble for the Duomo came in along the Naviglio Grande; the Darsena basin is now the centre of a busy bar district.
